card.name: The word online before resources
card.fires_on: The word "online" when it describes a web resource such as a store, dictionary, forum, or version. It is common in website navigation text like "Back to MedTerms online medical dictionary".

modes.description: "online" modifies a named reference, store, or version, often in site menu text.
